dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I think I'll stay here for a bit longer. The show is still not quite over in my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh, but if you wanted to chat, I'll happily oblige.

choices.text: What do you want to do afterward?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Matsuzaka and the others are still waiting for me so we can go hunt down the Great Mujina Youkai. I'm like a big sister to them, so I can't go back on my word.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Also, I want to go and ask everyone what they thought of the fireworks.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: And over the next few days, I'd also like to thank everyone for their support.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: That includes you and Paimon, too, of course.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: I did kind of force it on you, after all. Not to mention that I dragged you along with me and gave you all sorts of trouble along the way. Hehe, I'd feel bad if I charged you any Mora.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you sure? I feel bad...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: #It's fine. ...Look, how about we make a deal: After you find your {F#brother}{M#sister}, tell {F#him}{M#her} to come to Naganohara Fireworks for all {F#his}{M#her} fireworks needs. That way, I'll get another customer. Sound fair?

choices.text: What if the Tenryou Commission causes you more trouble...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hahaha, I'm joking. Didn't I tell you that my family deals with the Commissions quite a bit?

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: We have an easy enough time of it. At the worst, we'd have to apologize, smile, and pay a fine. It wouldn't be the end of the world.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: You two should be careful, though. Without the same connections, you can't afford to be as reckless as me, hee-hee.
